issues.explanation: Both methods mutate UI state without server-side authorization; mount/route gating limits impact but every Livewire action must authorize.
Record ID and modal flag are client-writable; tampering is mitigated by entity-scoped findOrFail plus manager authorization but violates the lock-server-context rule.
Invite/membership writes happen inline in Livewire components instead of one-class-per-use-case app/Actions; matches existing Members sibling style but deviates from the Actions rule.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:48-63 #[Validate]+#[Locked] entity and $this->validate(); authorize('update') on manager actions; migration with down(); docs/* + CHANGELOG updated; deviates: writes inline (EntityInvite::create) instead of app/Actions/*

readability.evidence: resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:1034-1098 clear Bulma modals; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:275-293 small helpers selectedMembership/inviteRateLimitKey/isInviteConflict; no dead code

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves invite-only membership (model/migration/mail/components/views/routes/lang/docs/tests); dashboard/nav tweaks enforce manager-only; no unrelated features

security.evidence: authorize('update') on sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole; scoped invites()->findOrFail / memberships()->findOrFail; validation inviteEmail/inviteRole/memberRole; {{ }} escaping; gaps: confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval lack authorize, selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval not #[Locked]

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Eloquent scopes, RateLimiter, Mail::queue, existing policies; minimum helpers; no new service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/EntityInviteTest.php:1163-1266 columns/normalization/casts/mail/queue; MembersTest.php:1300-1667 mount 403, invite, quota, case-insensitive, expired-replace, rate-limit, cancel/openMember/saveRole/confirmation/locales; PendingInvitesTest.php:1687-1844 filtering, accept/decline auth, expired, idempotent, onboarding hr

review.summary: Invite-only membership is fully implemented with model/migration/mail, PendingInvites accept/decline, and manager-only members page with detail and removal-confirmation modals, plus strong tests. Approve with nits for Livewire hardening (authorize trivial setters, lock server-only IDs) and the Actions-layer deviation.
